name: Thai Red Curry Fried Rice with Ground Pork, Carrots & Snap Peas

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water and salt, then bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups jasmine rice
3 cup water
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add pork, carrots, curry paste, and salt. Cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 5-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg lean ground pork
1 ½ (283 g) bags shredded carrots
⅓ cup Thai curry paste, red
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry snap peas. Cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (227 g) pkgs sugar snap peas

instructions.primary_message: When the pork is done, add snap peas and water to the pot. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the peas are just tender and sauce has thickened slightly, 2-3 minutes. Cover and remove from heat.
While the snap peas are cooking, wash, dry, and cut limes into wedges. Set aside for serving.
When the rice is done, add to the pot along with fish sauce. Set over high heat and cook, stirring constantly, until warmed through, 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide fried rice between plates or bowls. Squeeze lime over top and enjoy!
